There are 4 different movie clips, labeled A, B, C, D; for each clip you get 3 example trials recorded on different viewings of that clip. The query trial is from a new viewing of some clip. It may be one of the clips above, or a clip that is NOT among them. Decide which clip the mouse was watching during the query trial, or say that it matches none of them.
